snp5.10:1.1:
One in whom
no sensualities dwell;
snp5.10:1.5:
his emancipation:
What is it like?
snp5.10:2.5:
his emancipation
is not other than that.
snp5.10:3.1:
Todeyya:
Is he without desire,
or desiring?
snp5.10:3.3: Describe the sage to me, Sakyan,
snp5.10:3.4:
All-around Eye,
so that I may recognize
what he is like.
snp5.10:4.4:
as having nothing,
unentangled
in sensuality
& becoming.
